items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: Brother Willie, he used to play trumpet, but he didn't hardly play in the band. He was manager of the band.

ctx.x: Yeah, he died. Brother Willie, he used to play trumpet, but he didn't hardly play in the band. He was manager of the band. Willie, he died too. Willie Wilson?
Yeah, Willie Wilson, yeah. So his main job was to handle the band?
